master:
Precise local edit of the attached ORIGINAL FARMER sprite. This image is the authority for ENTIRE BODY PROPORTIONS, face-to-body size, neck length, shoulder/waist/hip widths, arm length and thickness, apron length, leg length and boot size. KEEP THE ORIGINAL DRAWING. Do not redesign, elongate neck/body, widen or slim it. The face is already correct: keep exactly these eyes, cheeks, chin, smile, beard and their proportions. Keep the rich original pixel-art material details, three-step cream sleeve folds, dimensional leather gloves/belt/pouch, gold buckles, layered brown boot straps and toe caps, olive apron pocket and diagonal cloth highlights.
Make ONLY two local corrections:
1. Scalp hair underneath hat must be neutral charcoal dark gray rather than brown, with tidy broad pixel clumps. Keep gray beard distinct and hat unchanged.
2. Viewer-left apron side should flare slightly diagonally toward hem and have a modest cloth fold; separate the short brown tool sheath from that fabric edge so they do not make one rigid vertical stripe. Keep pouch at belt, original detailed materials and proportions.
Everything else remains as the attached original. Empty hands, no carrots or other props. Genuine transparent alpha, no glow/backdrop/shadow. No blurry interpolation or antialiasing. Dark ONE native-pixel contours at final 96x128 logical grid, with distinct material shadow colors. Do NOT simplify or flatten material detail to enforce thin outlines. No global contour erosion, no skeletonization of leather/cloth folds. Same original source canvas and pose, complete character.
basic_body:
Make the modular BASIC CLOTHES UNDERLAYER of this exact ORIGINAL farmer. Preserve exactly the original body/head proportions, neck length, shoulders, limbs, hand positions, knees, boot shapes, pose and canvas. Do not elongate or slim/widen anything. Keep original pixel-art fold shading and material definition.
Remove hat: keep complete natural rounded charcoal-gray hair and scalp, tidy broad locks, no cut-off head. Keep face shape/nose/beard but remove only eyes/eyebrows and mouth line, filling those small slots with matching skin; do not erase the nose, beard or moustache.
Remove olive apron/straps/buckles/belt/tool pouch: reveal a simple cream shirt across the same torso, tucked into plain brown pants at the original belt/waist height. Continue the pants coherently under the removed apron, without changing visible original pant folds, knees, boot straps/buckles or toe caps.
Remove brown gloves: bare relaxed hands in the exact same positions and natural matching size. No fingers or skin pixels hanging as stray strips.
Keep original dark crisp 1-native-pixel contours and distinct material shadows, detailed cream rolled sleeves, original layered boots. Do not flatten shading, erode outlines, add random texture or redraw anatomy. Full source canvas same as target. Transparent PNG with no glow/background. This is a paper doll UNDERLAYER aligned to image 1, not a new character.
apron_underlay: Precise local edit of existing ORIGINAL farmer. Remove ONLY the waist belt and hanging brown tool pouch/sheath from over the apron. Fill all previously covered area with complete olive apron cloth, preserving the original apron length, silhouette, pocket, folds and directional color clusters. Keep natural side flare and cloth slit; no tool-shaped vertical black stripe or transparent cutouts. Gold shoulder buckles remain. EVERYTHING ELSE unchanged: face, eyes/smile/beard, gray hair, hat, original body proportions, sleeves, gloves, pants and detailed boots. Same canvas/pose/registration. Crisp pixel art, thin dark contours and separate material shadow colors, no erosion or flattening of folds. Transparent PNG, no glow or background.
